concerns.text: Task T001 claims to download a “publicly available 2025 CO₂ hydrogenation experimental TOF dataset (must be a real URL or DOI‑resolved CSV)”. FR‑001 requires this dataset, but the specification and research notes state that no open experimental TOF dataset is currently available. Requiring a real download without a source weakens FR‑001 and makes the task impossible to satisfy.

FR‑001 also mandates verification of a `required_columns.json` file matching the unified DataFrame. Task T001’s verification checklist only mentions file existence and checksums for the three raw files; it omits the required `required_columns.json` check, thereby dropping an acceptance criterion.

Task T006 fixes the outer hold‑out split to 20 % of the unified dataset, whereas FR‑010 specifies the held‑out fraction as “[deferred]” (to be defined later). By hard‑coding a concrete split size, the task retroactively narrows the scope of FR‑010, violating the functional requirement.
